A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Anchored Decoding and contain 53 readable pages, including Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable matching of the text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original copying–utility experiments across six model pairs, ablations, runtime measurements, and additional empirical evaluations in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the original model comparisons, ablations, runtime measurements, and appendix evaluations reported in v2.

M1.justification: The token-level and byte-level methods, prefix debt, adaptive budgeting, and TinyComma model are unchanged. Table 1 replaces the inconsistent PROXIMAL label with ANCHORED for the same method and results.

E1.justification: Both versions retain Common Pile training and the same evaluation coverage: BOOKS, BIOS, Creative prompts, news, downstream language tasks, and non-literal copying, including Appendix E.3.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main and appendix experiments, including SYSTEM, MEMFREE, RCAD, CP-FUSE, and TOKENSWAP where evaluated. Table 1's renamed row represents the proposed method, not a different comparator.

E3.justification: Model pairs, sample sizes, metrics, preprocessing, decoding settings, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. Section 5.2 merely rephrases its description of the same token-level ablation setting.

E4.justification: The objective, prefix-debt, and budgeting ablations are retained, together with the copying diagnostics, sensitivity studies, long-tail analysis, and qualitative examples. Figure 6's caption revision introduces no new analysis.

E5.justification: The three-seed reporting, means and standard deviations, error bars, repeated runtime measurements, and appendix correlation statistics are unchanged.

E6.justification: Figure 6 changes its qualitative description of Copyright prefix-debt distributions from 'markedly right-shifted' to 'more right-skewed' relative to Creative and Factual. This changes the stated distributional property; the plotted curves, numerical results, rankings, and generated examples remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, equations, guarantees, and derivations are unchanged. Appendix B.1.2 adds punctuation and connective wording to Lemma B.1's proof without changing its mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same contributions and claims concerning safety guarantees, cross-tokenizer decoding, TinyComma, and the copying–utility trade-off.

C2.justification: The memorization-based mechanism explanation, prefix-debt rationale, applicability boundaries, and limitations in Appendix A.3 are unchanged. Figure 6's revised observational description is not accompanied by a revised mechanism or implication.

D1.justification: Implementation details, training configurations, hardware, preprocessing instructions, and efficiency procedures are unchanged. Appendix A.1 retains the same code and model access links.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Colin Raffel is added to the acknowledgments, without adding a cited work or revising the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Small wording and punctuation edits occur in Sections 3.5 and 5.2 and Lemma B.1's proof. The method label, Figure 6 caption, acknowledgments, and version stamp are updated; the narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1's method-row label and Figure 6's caption change, accompanied by limited text and table reflow. No figures or tables are added or removed, and the plotted graphics remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting Table 1's method name removes a small inconsistency. Figure 6 switches from a location description to a skewness description without changing the plots or accompanying analysis, so it is not an established accuracy improvement. Together with the remaining copyedits, these localized changes leave the paper's overall clarity, rigor, evidence, and reproducibility essentially unchanged.
